notes.title: Full Release!
notes.content:
We are very happy to announce that with the latest live Patch 1.11, Beware of Trains leaves Early Access program. Patch 1.11 also includes:
[list]
[*] New maps
[*] Some bugfixes
[/list]
Thank you for your support and stay tuned for more!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228591/bda9805f254e9dc0063d956ce5132a978b32657e.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.10 is Live
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that special [b]XMas Patch 1.10[/b] is live.
There's a ton of new content, including:
[list]
[*] Five maps with new themes, tons of stuff to blow up and crazy new objectives to do
[*] Special [b]XMAS[/b] Level!
[*] Better tutorials
[*] Tweaks in gameplay, balance and difficulty level
[*] Improved UX
[*] A lot of bugfixes
[/list]
Thank you for your support and feedback.
Stay tuned, have fun and happy mayhem!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228591/78d6e5280c4259f2033d752af4fdd3c16493e7a8.png[/img]

tags.feature: Five maps with new themes, tons of stuff to blow up and crazy new objectives to do

notes.title: Patch 1.05 is Live
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that [b]Patch 1.05[/b] is live.
It contains a small batch of fixes that will make your rail mayhem experience better:
[list]
[*] Black hole is properly clickable now
[*] Minor difficulty tweaks
[*] Tepee is now properly counted as destroyed
[*] Small UI and gameplay adjustments
[/list]
Thank you all for your support and feedback.
Stay tuned...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228591/415604097cd0eeb0bb2c7f9c16328f59d0e3b0ef.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.03 is Live
notes.content:
Thanks to your feedback we have created and deployed [b]Patch 1.03[/b].
It contains a list of improvements and fixes that should make gameplay much better:
[list]
[*] Improved level loading speed
[*] Fixed level finishing behaviour
[*] Fixed several level conditions
[*] Various difficulty level tweaks
[*] Tools UI rendering on top fixed
[*] Music volume turned down
[*] Music will continue playing while reloading levels
[*] Some minor playlist adjustments
[/list]
Stay tuned for future updates and don't stop the rail mayhem...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228591/bcc17780d541f93b9afc6b27c185d484c19e8754.png[/img]

tags.bug: Tools UI rendering on top fixed

tags.feature: Music will continue playing while reloading levels
